name_story.story: Khadizha can be understood through the Arabic form خَدِيجَة, whose central sense is khadizha; khadija (caucasian form). Khadizha is the Caucasian form of Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja), the name of the Prophet's first wife.

faq.a: Khadizha is associated with the Arabic form خَدِيجَة, whose core sense is khadizha; khadija (caucasian form).

faq.q: What is the origin of Khadizha?
faq.a: Khadizha is associated with Arabic. Khadizha is the Caucasian form of Arabic خَدِيجَة (Khadīja), the name of the Prophet's first wife.
Yes — the underlying form خَدِيجَة is Arabic.
Khadizha can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Khadizha should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Khadīja is not a Quranic personal name.

faq.q: What does Khadizha mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Khadizha is rendered خدیجہ and carries the sense خدیجہ، زوجہ نبی.

faq.q: What does Khadizha mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Khadizha is rendered خدیجه and carries the sense خدیجه، نام همسر پیامبر.
A romanized syllable approximation is kha-diz-ha. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Khadizha?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Khadizha, khadizha. Script forms are خديجه, خدیجه, خدیجہ, خَدِيجَة, ख़दीज़ा.

faq.q: Is Khadizha a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as female. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
